tasks.subject: Task 1: Decouple VersionFormat from git.Project
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Supprimer Format de Project, passer VersionFormat en paramètre à LastTag(), ajouter IsHeadTagged(), NewProjectFromRepo(), corriger les retours d'erreur.

**Files:**
- Modify: `git/git.go`
- Modify: `git/git_test.go`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Project struct sans champ Format
- [ ] NewProject(path, sha string) — deux params
- [ ] LastTag(f format.VersionFormat) accepte format en param
- [ ] IsHeadTagged(tag string) (bool, error) ajouté
- [ ] NewProjectFromRepo(repo, hash) ajouté
- [ ] go test ./git/ -v → PASS

**Verify:** `go test ./git/ -v` → all PASS

```json:metadata
{"files": ["git/git.go", "git/git_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "go test ./git/ -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Project struct sans Format", "LastTag accepte VersionFormat param", "IsHeadTagged ajouté", "NewProjectFromRepo ajouté", "tous les tests passent"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: SemverFormat with constraints
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implémenter SemverFormat dans strategy/semver avec Prefix et Constraints (major/minor/patch).

**Files:**
- Create: `strategy/semver/semver.go` (SemverFormat uniquement)
- Create: `strategy/semver/semver_test.go` (tests format)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] IsValid valide semver de base
- [ ] Prefix "v" accepte "v1.0.0" et rejette "1.0.0"
- [ ] Constraint major=1 rejette "2.0.0"
- [ ] Constraints major=1+minor=2 rejette "1.3.0"
- [ ] SemverFormat implémente format.VersionFormat (compile-time check)
- [ ] go test ./strategy/semver/ -v → PASS

**Verify:** `go test ./strategy/semver/ -v` → all PASS

```json:metadata
{"files": ["strategy/semver/semver.go", "strategy/semver/semver_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "go test ./strategy/semver/ -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["IsValid basique", "Prefix support", "Constraints major/minor/patch", "interface check"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Strategy — Last() and Current()
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Ajouter Strategy avec Last() et Current() dans strategy/semver, avec interface GitProject et tests in-memory.

**Files:**
- Modify: `strategy/semver/semver.go` (ajouter Strategy, GitProject interface)
- Modify: `strategy/semver/semver_test.go` (ajouter tests strategy)
- Modify: `git/git.go` (ajouter NewProjectFromRepo)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Last() retourne Initial quand pas de tag
- [ ] Last() retourne le dernier tag valide
- [ ] Last() respecte les contraintes major du pattern de branche
- [ ] Current() retourne le tag exact si HEAD est tagué
- [ ] Current() retourne le dernier tag sur branche release non taguée
- [ ] Current() retourne version formatée sur branche pre-release
- [ ] go test ./git/ ./strategy/semver/ -v → PASS

**Verify:** `go test ./git/ ./strategy/semver/ -v` → all PASS

```json:metadata
{"files": ["strategy/semver/semver.go", "strategy/semver/semver_test.go", "git/git.go"], "verifyCommand": "go test ./git/ ./strategy/semver/ -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Last retourne initial", "Last retourne dernier tag", "contraintes de branche", "Current HEAD tagué", "Current release branch", "Current pre-release formaté"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Wire CLI — current and last commands
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Câbler les commandes current et last dans command/commands.go, ajouter --repo flag, supprimer format/semver.go.

**Files:**
- Modify: `command/commands.go`
- Modify: `git/git_test.go` (update import pour SemverFormat)
- Delete: `format/semver.go`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] gg-version current imprime la version et exit 0
- [ ] gg-version last imprime le dernier tag et exit 0
- [ ] --repo flag fonctionne (défaut ".")
- [ ] --config flag fonctionne (défaut ".gg-version.yml")
- [ ] go build ./... → succès
- [ ] go test ./... → all PASS

**Verify:** `go build ./... && go test ./...` → PASS

```json:metadata
{"files": ["command/commands.go", "git/git_test.go", "format/semver.go"], "verifyCommand": "go build ./... && go test ./...", "acceptanceCriteria": ["current command", "last command", "--repo flag", "--config flag", "build clean", "all tests pass"]}
```
